notes.title: [Update] New Features and System Optimizations to Enhance Village Experience
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Market[/b]: A new market system has been added, where villagers will autonomously purchase resources and goods from the village. The Pawn interface also now includes an auto-selling feature, with the number of auto-sell slots expanding as more market buildings are built.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Well[/b]: A new convenience facility – the Well – has been introduced, directly increasing the village's livability and attracting more villagers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lumberyard, Quarry, Farm, Fish Hut[/b]: These four resource collection transfer buildings will automatically assign villagers to gather the corresponding resources.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Theater[/b]: A new convenience facility – the Theater – where villagers will go during their leisure time to watch performances, further enhancing the livability of the village.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Warehouse[/b]: A new building – the Warehouse – expands the village's storage capacity, helping players better manage resources.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resource Collection Official Position[/b]: A new official position system allows players to assign villagers to the resource collection official position, increasing resource production in specific areas of the village.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Villager Joining Mechanism[/b]: A new system for allowing more villagers to join the village.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Village Management Page[/b]: A new feature has been added to the village management page, providing estimates for the number and types of enemies, helping players plan their strategy better.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Village Tax Adjustment[/b]: A tax rate adjustment feature has been added to the village management page. By adjusting the tax rate, players can increase copper coin production during patrol cycles, but this will also reduce livability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Divine Map Unlock[/b]: All new content has been unlocked through the Divine Map.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603375/f638364490088fd802aacca2cc7f4e82cef5eeb4.gif"][/img]
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Adjustments:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Redesigned Core Interaction UI[/b]: The interaction structure has been simplified to make the game controls more intuitive and smoother.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Redesigned Camera Interaction[/b]: The camera operation has been optimized, making perspective adjustments more fluid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Redesigned Scenes[/b]: The number of tiles in the scene has been expanded, and the scene generation rules have been optimized.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized Villager Pathfinding Logic[/b]: Reduced the impact of villager numbers on performance and introduced a feature where villagers leave footprints and prioritize walking along paths.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized Save Nodes[/b]: The save functionality has been optimized to ensure a more stable game save experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted Item Selling Prices[/b]: The selling prices of all items have been recalculated, and the balance of some crafting recipes has been optimized.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized Road Node Count[/b]: The number of road nodes with the same path length has been reduced, making patrols easier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted Attack Speed Algorithm[/b]: The attack speed calculation formula has been further optimized.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Residential Contribution of Houses[/b]: The contribution of residential houses has been increased to +2.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased Event Probability[/b]: The probability of encountering various events on roads has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased Manufacturing Experience Output[/b]: Manufacturing actions now generate more experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monster Stats Adjustment[/b]: The growth rate of monster stats has been reduced, and the amount of cultivation experience obtained has been increased.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603375/f0819481cfad0fcb68cc0886808e35a393b13b7d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][p]All currently reported medium to high-priority bugs have been fixed, totaling 46 items.[/p]

tags.feature: [b]Market[/b]: A new market system has been added, where villagers will autonomously purchase resources and goods from the village. The Pawn interface also now includes an auto-selling feature, with the number of auto-sell slots expanding as more market buildings are built.
[b]Well[/b]: A new convenience facility – the Well – has been introduced, directly increasing the village's livability and attracting more villagers.
[b]Lumberyard, Quarry, Farm, Fish Hut[/b]: These four resource collection transfer buildings will automatically assign villagers to gather the corresponding resources.
[b]Theater[/b]: A new convenience facility – the Theater – where villagers will go during their leisure time to watch performances, further enhancing the livability of the village.
[b]Warehouse[/b]: A new building – the Warehouse – expands the village's storage capacity, helping players better manage resources.

[b]Resource Collection Official Position[/b]: A new official position system allows players to assign villagers to the resource collection official position, increasing resource production in specific areas of the village.
[b]Villager Joining Mechanism[/b]: A new system for allowing more villagers to join the village.
[b]Village Management Page[/b]: A new feature has been added to the village management page, providing estimates for the number and types of enemies, helping players plan their strategy better.

[b]Village Tax Adjustment[/b]: A tax rate adjustment feature has been added to the village management page. By adjusting the tax rate, players can increase copper coin production during patrol cycles, but this will also reduce livability.
[b]Divine Map Unlock[/b]: All new content has been unlocked through the Divine Map.

tags.balance_change: [b]Redesigned Core Interaction UI[/b]: The interaction structure has been simplified to make the game controls more intuitive and smoother.
[b]Redesigned Camera Interaction[/b]: The camera operation has been optimized, making perspective adjustments more fluid.
[b]Redesigned Scenes[/b]: The number of tiles in the scene has been expanded, and the scene generation rules have been optimized.
[b]Optimized Villager Pathfinding Logic[/b]: Reduced the impact of villager numbers on performance and introduced a feature where villagers leave footprints and prioritize walking along paths.
[b]Optimized Save Nodes[/b]: The save functionality has been optimized to ensure a more stable game save experience.
[b]Adjusted Item Selling Prices[/b]: The selling prices of all items have been recalculated, and the balance of some crafting recipes has been optimized.
[b]Optimized Road Node Count[/b]: The number of road nodes with the same path length has been reduced, making patrols easier.
[b]Adjusted Attack Speed Algorithm[/b]: The attack speed calculation formula has been further optimized.
[b]Improved Residential Contribution of Houses[/b]: The contribution of residential houses has been increased to +2.
[b]Increased Event Probability[/b]: The probability of encountering various events on roads has been increased.
[b]Increased Manufacturing Experience Output[/b]: Manufacturing actions now generate more experience.
[b]Monster Stats Adjustment[/b]: The growth rate of monster stats has been reduced, and the amount of cultivation experience obtained has been increased.

notes.title: 【Update Notes】We've adjusted many gameplay elements!
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all for your amazing feedback during the Steam Next Fest! After going through everyone's comments, we found that most of the problems stem from one central issue: [b]“the game isn’t idle enough.”[/b] So we went back to the drawing board, redesigned, and polished a lot of core systems to ensure you can enjoy a more relaxing, fishy experience. Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes & Adjustments：

Village Construction Module[/h2][h3]Many players said the village-building experience demanded too much attention — needing to wait for the right cards while also fearing villagers might deplete planned tiles, invalidating layout bonuses. So we've made the following changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Construction has been removed from the deck and moved to a [b]dedicated building UI[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Basic buildings and environments now use [b]unified shapes[/b], no longer consuming special card art (rare/special buildings will retain unique visuals).[/p][/*][*][p]Villager gathering [b]no longer affects[/b] your planned layout bonuses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Demolition is now a standalone, free function[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some build data wasn’t correctly recorded.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Villager Interaction & Planning Management[/h2][h3]We also heard a lot about how the villager system was too hands-on or lacking key functions. Here are the changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Removed RTS-style interactions. Players [b]can no longer directly control[/b] villager movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]new villager management UI[/b] to view stats and directly assign professions or output preferences for each villager.[/p][/*][*][p]Villagers now [b]gain experience[/b] through gathering and production.[/p][/*][*][p]Villagers [b]level up[/b] and improve their attributes over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Resource gathering is now [b]based on periodic global stats[/b], instead of individual villager trips.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Adventure Loop Adjustments[/h2][h3]Our dice-based movement and event system required constant attention to make the most of rewards. So we simplified the mechanic:[/h3][list][*][p]Removed dice rolls — movement is now player-controlled [b]start/stop travel[/b], and [b]all tile effects are triggered on pass-through[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tile events now trigger [b]with a probability per loop[/b], rather than based on distance.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Trickster" minigame and related features have been temporarily removed due to negative feedback and excess complexity.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Resource Gathering System[/h2][h3]Here are some fixes and improvements based on your feedback:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]mining nodes could be harvested twice[/b] if refreshed mid-action.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crafting jobs can now occasionally yield rare or locked materials[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]We completely rebalanced the [b]time-cost curves[/b] for all gathering and crafting interactions to make them feel smoother and more consistent.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1] New Content[/h1][list][*][p][b]Warehouse construction[/b] is now available! Build warehouses to [b]expand your backpack space[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Villager Arrival[/b]: New road event where passing by may attract villagers to join your village.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Village Management UI[/b] added! View bonuses provided by your buildings — future updates will expand this into a full progression system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Village Log UI[/b] added! When the game is windowed or minimized, this will display dynamic updates about village events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new villagers and [b]natural encounter events[/b], as well as a [b]new item type: “Fateful Encounter”[/b], which is [b]unique, non-usable[/b], and [b]essential for unlocking storylines[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Villagers now have [b]trait tags[/b], giving them unique personalities, stat boosts, and surprises.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a system for [b]village positions[/b], where assigning roles to villagers grants layered bonuses. (Now in test — full release next update.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a batch of [b]functional ability cards[/b] — granting experience, reputation, healing, and more. Buff-type cards coming soon![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]In addition to the above, we’ve fixed [b]43 bugs[/b] large and small — too many to list, so we’ll spare you the patchwork scroll. [/p][p]This concludes our development report for this phase. Huge thanks to everyone for your support, patience, and feedback! We’re now entering full development on [b]Chapter Two[/b], which will bring [b]multiple sects[/b], [b]diverse combat styles[/b], and [b]village building rewards unique to each path[/b].[/p][p]If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to drop by our [b]community channels[/b], use the in-game [b]Feedback[/b] button.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p]As always… please don’t forget to wishlist us 🥹[/p][p]With love,
[b]Fish Princess[/b] [/p]

notes.title: 【Dev Update】Next Fest Recap & What’s Coming Next
notes.content:
[p]Dear Village Leaders,[/p][p]Thank you so much for playing the [b]Idle Frontier Demo[/b] during Steam Next Fest!
We received an overwhelming amount of feedback, encouragement, and (sometimes very surprising but super helpful) suggestions from all of you. It was our first time sharing this world, and we're truly grateful that so many of you were willing to step into this still-developing spiritual land.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][/h2][h2]Here are the most common questions we received — and our official replies:[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1. Why is there no language support besides Simplified Chinese?[/b][/h3][p]Before releasing the Demo, we reviewed our own localization and realized… there were way too many mistranslations, missing lines, and awkward expressions that would have completely ruined the first impression for non-Chinese players.
So to ensure a decent first experience, we temporarily disabled other languages.[/p][p]Once the game’s full script stabilizes, we’ll be redoing the translation thoroughly and will release proper multilingual support. We sincerely hope to provide a comfortable experience for players of all languages in the near future.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. “Idle” game? Not idle enough![/b][/h3][p]We hear you.[/p][p]From day one, our design goal was to let players [b]choose how to engage[/b] — go deep when focused, go idle when distracted. But clearly, we haven’t hit the sweet spot yet.[/p][p]The good news? Thanks to your feedback, we’ve now locked in a clearer direction, one that balances automation and interactivity better — and this direction has been affirmed by many core players.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. What about bugs and stability issues?[/b][/h3][p]We know — there were some weird bugs at launch.
Due to our tiny team, we weren’t able to do a full QA pass pre-release. In fact, the Next Fest served as our first large-scale open test.[/p][p]Thanks to your detailed reports and patience, we managed to squash nearly all major bugs by Day 2. We’re confident that the Demo is now stable enough for continued play.[/p][p]And that’s why — yes — [b]the Demo will remain available even after Next Fest[/b], until we’re ready to transition into full release.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Will save data be wiped? How long will the Demo last? Will achievements be added?[/b][/h3][p]We plan to keep the Demo up [b]until development for the full version is complete[/b].[/p][p]The core systems and data structures are already in place, and we don’t expect major overhauls — so your Demo save data [b]will carry over[/b] to the full version.
(If you want to transfer your save in the future, feel free to reach out to us via our community or Discord!)[/p][p]Achievements are ready but will be launched with the full version, once the data tracking is finalized. We don’t want to give players unstable goals that might change later.[/p][p][/p][p]If we haven’t answered your question here, feel free to post it in the [b]Steam Discussions[/b], [b]our community group[/b], or anywhere you hang out — we’ll respond to everyone![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]What's Next — Our Development Roadmap[/h2][p]Thanks to your feedback, our team has defined the next milestones and features. Here's our rough version plan:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]0.1.x[/b] [i](Current Demo)[/i][/h3][list][*][p]Chapter 1 content[/p][/*][*][p]Core gameplay: building the village, patrolling, cultivating[/p][/*][*][p]Basic gathering and crafting systems[/p][/*][*][p]Assign villagers to simple tasks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]0.2.x[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Chapter 2 content[/p][/*][*][p]Choose a religious sect and unlock new spells and sect events[/p][/*][*][p]Village management: promotions, villager training and specialization[/p][/*][*][p]Dispatch villagers to collect rare items, fame, and treasures[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]0.3.x[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Chapter 3 content[/p][/*][*][p]Capture and raise spirit beasts with their own training systems[/p][/*][*][p]“Village War” system: send out spirit beasts to raid other players’ villages[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]1.0.x (Full Release)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Full localization[/p][/*][*][p]Achievement system[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfixes after closed beta[/p][/*][*][p]A new guided intro and main story arc[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]In parallel, we’ll also be expanding:[/p][list][*][p]Equipment, items, and materials[/p][/*][*][p]New events (some inspired by classic Chinese tales)[/p][/*][*][p]More village structures and building options[/p][/*][*][p]Ongoing balance tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Of course, all your bug reports and suggestions![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Help Us Build This World[/h2][p]You can stay involved and follow development by:[/p][list][*][p]Posting your suggestions here in [b]Steam Discussions[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Joining our [b]player community[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Keep an eye out for a possible [b]closed beta[/b] coming later this year![/p][/*][/list][p]And if you enjoyed the game, [b]please consider adding it to your Wishlist[/b] — it helps us more than you can imagine![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you to every one of you who tried the Demo during Next Fest.
We know our little immortal village still has a long way to go.
But together with you, we’ll turn this land into a thriving realm of cultivation and peace.[/p][p]See you in the next update! 🙌[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]With much love,
🐟 Fish Princess [/p]

notes.title: [Version Update] Routine Fixes and Additions for the Demo Version
notes.content: [p]First of all, a huge thank you to all the players who chose to try out our demo during the New Product Festival, a celebration filled with outstanding games. We're even more grateful for all the suggestions and bug reports you’ve shared with us during your playthrough. We’ve pulled some late nights to bring you updates as quickly as possible![/p][p]During this period, we've been updating the demo [b]2 to 4 times a day[/b], each update including the latest fixes and changes. We apologize if this high frequency of updates has affected your gameplay experience.[/p][p]Here are today’s update details:[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, monsters dropped items not meant for this version of the game. (We weren’t hiding anything—these items were part of planned future content.) In this update, we adjusted the loot tables and added legality checks for items in the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a font display issue on some manufacturing UI screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where dice values could unexpectedly become negative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug preventing alchemy experience from saving or loading correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed save/load bugs related to consumables in the quiver (arrows, darts, needles, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a freeze issue when players reached the Waterworks Department and triggered the slot machine minigame during patrol.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balance Adjustments:[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced the chance of triggering the "Pig Demon Eats Villagers" outcome in the \[Natural Events].[/p][p](“I finally gathered 9 hardworking villagers, went AFK for a bit... came back and Mr. Hammibal Lecter had snacked on two of them. notes.title: 【Patch Notes】Bug Fixes + New Asynchronous PvP Feature!
notes.content:
This update brings several improvements, fixes, and exciting new gameplay features:

Fixes：
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where attribute points were not properly converted into combat stats on some devices.
[*]Fixed an occasional bug where gathering or crafting yields were lower than expected.
[*]Adjusted the size of event icons on the road to prevent visual overlap.
[/olist]

Balance Adjustments: 
[olist]
[*]Rebalanced the production and consumption ratio of Spirit Dice.
[/olist]

New Features：
[olist]
[*]Added a Combat Power Leaderboard.
[*]Moved “Huashan Duel” (Leaderboard PvP) to Chapter 1 in the Celestial Path (仙途图谱), allowing players to unlock PvP earlier.
[*]Introduced asynchronous player-vs-player battles (Huashan Duel):
Players can now upload their character data (equipment, level, stats, etc.) to the Steam leaderboard, and challenge others with similar rankings in offline battles.
If you encounter any 0-HP enemies during the challenge, don’t worry — those are internal test characters we uploaded for fun. Go ahead and smash them!
[/olist]

We will continue maintaining the stability of the Demo version while actively developing new content according to our roadmap. A development preview update will be released soon to share our future gameplay plans with you.

If you enjoyed the demo, or would like to share your thoughts, suggestions, or ask about upcoming features — we warmly welcome you to join our community or official QQ group!

With love,
The Fish Princess

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Thank You for Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thank you so much for all your feedback in the community! Based on your input, we’ve made the following improvements while continuing to push forward with our development schedule:

Bug Fixes：
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where events could occasionally interrupt automatic patrolling.
[*]Fixed UI scaling issues in some mini-games.
[*]Fixed incorrect artwork on some cards.
[/olist]

Balance Adjustments：
[olist]
[*]Increased the formula contribution of Stamina to max HP, while slightly reducing the effect of Strength on max HP.
[*]Increased dice yield rate by 12%.
[*]Adjusted critical hit formula, increasing equipment-based crit damage bonus by 30%.
[*]The Spirit Dice generation in the Spirit Tower is now triggered by weather changes instead of a fixed 5-minute timer.
[/olist]

New Features：
[olist]
[*]Added a new camera control option. In addition to classic RTS-style mouse scrolling, you can now move the screen using the keyboard, or a hybrid mode (keyboard has priority). This can be customized in the settings.
[*]Added a new functional card that allows terrain removal, along with its corresponding unlock method in the Celestial Map.
[*]Added two new natural events.
[/olist]

We truly appreciate all your suggestions and support. We’ll continue to polish and expand Idle Frontier: The Fishing Immortal Village, and we hope it becomes a game you truly love.

With love,
The Fish Princess
